Describe and price the site-survey process for existing and new restaurants, including

Indicate whether the proposed solution can reuse or adapt to existing equipment or 
whether new equipment is required. Identify assumptions and site validation needed. 
Yes. Genius can generally support the reuse of Pollo Campero’s existing digital menu

through a controllerless deployment model.

mounting, power requirements, network infrastructure, and overall system

retained and provide recommendations that balance reliability, performance, and total 
cost of ownership.

One unified partner for payments, POS, Back Office, and more.

Genius also directly drives revenue growth and customer engagement by expanding

Revenue Potential of Genius 
The full Genius solution boosts revenue by removing friction across the entire buying

1. Capture more sales across every channel 
Genius enables businesses to sell in-store, online, and on the go within a single

prefer to shop. By supporting all major payment types, including contactless, mobile 
wallets, and global digital payment methods, it reduces checkout friction and increases 
conversion rates. When customers can pay quickly and easily with their preferred 
method, they are more likely to complete purchases and spend more per transaction.

Marketing, loyalty, and gift card capabilities can help businesses actively drive higher 
spending and customer retention. Promotions and loyalty incentives encourage upsells 
and repeat visits, while seamless customer experiences, especially in restaurants and 
retail, improve satisfaction and lifetime value. Over time, this leads to more frequent 
transactions and higher average order values, directly contributing to revenue growth.  
3. Improve speed, efficiency, and throughput 
By streamlining operations, from order entry to payment processing, Genius allows 
businesses to serve more customers in less time. Faster checkout lines, synchronized 
front and back of house operations, and mobile POS capabilities help increase 
transaction volume, especially during peak periods. The ability to take payments 
anywhere (e.g., kiosks, handheld devices) also helps capture incremental sales that 
might otherwise be lost due to long wait times or limited checkout capacity.

Bottom line: Genius doesn’t just process payments—it actively creates revenue by

Additional Security for your Business 
The full Genius solution improves security by embedding enterprise-grade protections 
directly into every step of the payment and transaction lifecycle—reducing risk while 
maintaining a seamless customer experience. 
1. End-to-end protection of payment data 
Genius uses end-to-end encryption and tokenization to secure sensitive cardholder 
data from the moment of capture through processing. This ensures that payment 
information is never exposed in readable form, effectively eliminating opportunities for 
interception or misuse. By replacing raw card data with tokens, businesses minimize 
their exposure to breaches and significantly reduce the scope of sensitive data stored 
in their environment.  
2. Built-in PCI-compliant infrastructure 
The platform is designed to meet PCI-DSS compliance standards, which are the 
industry benchmark for payment security. This means businesses leveraging Genius 
benefit from a system that is already aligned with strict regulatory requirements for 
handling payment data. As a result, organizations reduce their compliance burden, 
avoid potential penalties, and maintain trust with customers who expect secure 
transactions.  
3. Reduced risk through a unified ecosystem
